name: How long does a typical wood fence repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical wood fence repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a wood fence repair depends significantly on the extent and type of damage. Minor repairs, such as replacing a few pickets or adjusting a gate, might be completed in a few hours. More extensive repairs, like replacing several rotted posts or multiple fence panels, could take one to two days. During our initial assessment, a representative from Maine Results, Inc. will provide an estimated timeline for your specific project, considering factors like material availability and current scheduling in our operational regions like Star and Nampa.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; minor fixes can take hours, while extensive post or panel replacements might require one to two days. We provide a timeline after assessing the damage.
